# Feature request / 功能请求

Do not use a public issue to report a suspected security vulnerability. Follow
the private instructions in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) or its
[Simplified Chinese counterpart](../../SECURITY.zh-CN.md).

不要用公开 issue 报告疑似安全漏洞。请遵循
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) 或其
[简体中文版本](../../SECURITY.zh-CN.md)中的私密说明。

Submitting this request does not promise acceptance or implementation. /
提交此请求并不承诺它会被接受或实现。

## Required confirmations / 必需确认

- [ ] I am not reporting a security vulnerability. / 我报告的不是安全漏洞。
- [ ] No secret or private data is included. / 未包含 secret 或私人数据。
- [ ] This request does not assume that GPU, cluster, Web UI, RDE Continual
      Learning, or RDE Assurance already exists. / 此请求不假定 GPU、cluster、
      Web UI、RDE Continual Learning 或 RDE Assurance 已经存在。
- [ ] I considered backward compatibility. / 我已考虑 backward compatibility。

## Problem statement / 问题陈述

## Real user scenario / 真实用户场景

## Why this belongs in RDE Core / 为什么这属于 RDE Core

## Alternatives considered / 已考虑的替代方案

## Proposed contract impact / 提议的合同影响

**Public API / Public API**

**RunSpec or RunBundle / RunSpec 或 RunBundle**

**SQLite / SQLite**

**Replay / Replay**

**Compatibility / Compatibility**

**Portability / Portability**

**Documentation / Documentation**

## Extension boundary / Extension 边界

Could this proposal instead be an external adapter or a separate package? Why
or why not? / 此提议是否可以改为外部 adapter 或独立 package？为什么可以或为什么
不可以？
